# Realty 25 AZ

> Property management for single-family rentals in North Scottsdale and nearby, Arizona.
> Designated Broker: Alik Levin. Phone: 480.920.2273. Email: info@realty25az.com.

Flat monthly management: $125 per door ($185 for rents over $4,000/mo). $0 when vacant.
Placement: 4.5% of gross rent. Lease renewal: $250. $0 markup on repairs. No long-term contracts.
